facts.text: They say the Drifting Spire sinks a finger-width every winter and rises again by spring.
The monks at Hollowmere say Old Aurum has not landed in living memory.
Niall Miller left Millbrook for Brightwater with 64 grain.
Niall Miller left Brightwater for Highmoor with 40 flour.
A dry roof caught fire in Highmoor. The watch called a bucket line from the well.

facts.text: Highmoor's bread reserve is low; households substitute river fish while the market seeks flour.
Aldric Marsh left Highmoor for Saltmere with a sealed report.
The bucket line extinguished the fire in Highmoor. A scorched home awaits repair (55% condition).
Niall Miller delivered 40 flour to Highmoor.
Niall Miller brought word: Niall Miller left Brightwater for Highmoor with 40 flour.
